prompt: Copilot cloud agent commits are cryptographically signed. What operational benefit does this provide?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, signed commits appear as Verified, providing confidence that AI-generated changes are authentic and untampered — critical for audit and accountability in multi-agent pipelines.

options.text: Commits appear as "Verified" — confirming they were made by the agent and have not been altered, supporting audit and accountability
